name: wazuh
_comment: Translates Sigma field names to the field names in a Wazuh indexer.
A logsource may set 'template' (a naming convention applied to every field)
and/or 'fields' (explicit entries, which override the template). A Sigma
field matching neither is reported as unmapped rather than guessed at.
VERIFY THESE AGAINST YOUR OWN INDEX before trusting a decay score built on
them. A field name that does not exist reads as 0% populate — permanent,
Wazuh's Sysmon decoder lowercases the first letter of each EventData
field, so Image -> data.win.eventdata.image. That convention is the
template; data.win.eventdata.image is confirmed against this repo's
Deliberately left without a template. Linux process telemetry reaches
a Wazuh index through auditd, and the field layout depends on your
audit rules and decoder — there is no single convention to assume.
Fill this in from your own index; until you do, every Linux rule
reports its fields as unmapped, which is the honest answer.
